📍 Duffey Lake Road, British Columbia, Canada 🇨🇦

A dramatic U-shaped hairpin bend winds down the mountainside above Seton Lake, offering sweeping views of turquoise water and rugged peaks.

Would you drive this scenic route?

#Travel #TravelPhotography #Canada

📍 Lake Brienz, Switzerland 🇨🇭

A traditional wooden chalet sits above striking turquoise waters, surrounded by the dramatic peaks of the Swiss Alps.

The peaceful lakeside scenery is hard to forget.

Would you spend a few days here?

#Travel #TravelPhotography #Switzerland

📍 Ol Doinyo Lengai, Tanzania 🇹🇿

Known as the “Mountain of God” in the Maasai language, this active volcano rises above the East African Rift Valley.

It is famous for its unusual carbonatite lava, which flows at much lower temperatures than typical lava.🌋

#Travel #TravelPhotography #Tanzania

📍 South Falls, Silver Falls State Park, Oregon, USA 🇺🇸

Water plunges 177 feet over a dramatic basalt cliff, creating one of Oregon’s most impressive waterfalls.

A trail even lets you walk behind the cascade.

Would you take the hike?

#Travel #TravelPhotography #Oregon

📍 Emerald Lake, Yoho National Park, Canada 🇨🇦

Brilliant turquoise water reflects the surrounding forest and towering Rocky Mountain peaks.

Its peaceful shoreline and stunning scenery make it a Canadian Rockies favourite.

Would you visit in summer or winter?

#Travel #TravelPhotography #Canada

📍 Lake Powell, Utah, USA 🇺🇸

Deep blue water winds between towering red sandstone cliffs, creating a striking contrast across the desert landscape.

This vast reservoir is a paradise for boating and exploring hidden canyons.

Would you visit?

#Travel #TravelPhotography #Utah

📍 Hochosterwitz Castle, Carinthia, Austria 🇦🇹 

Perched dramatically on a limestone hill, this medieval fortress is famous for its series of 14 historic gates leading up to the castle. 

A remarkable piece of Austrian history. 

Would you climb to the top?

#Travel #TravelPhotography #Austria
